context: A uni student interviews a retired executive about company-building
purpose: Teach: ビジョン/不況/意向/階層/儲け/結成/継承/有力

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本日はよろしくお願いします。まず、創業当時の企業ビジョンを教えていただけますか。
lines.en: Thank you for today. First, could you tell me about your founding company vision?
lines.style: Polite student interviewer, respectful and slightly nervous opening tone.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: うむ、諸君のような若者に話せるのは嬉しい。最初は仲間三人で会社を結成したんだ。
lines.en: Well, it's a joy to speak to young people like you. We started by founding the company with three colleagues.
lines.style: Warm elder statesman, slow deliberate cadence, reminiscent and avuncular.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 三人で、ですか。当時は長引く不況の影響もあったと聞きますが、何事もなく進みましたか。
lines.en: Just three of you? I heard the prolonged recession was a factor too — did things go smoothly?
lines.style: Curious follow-up, leaning forward, careful academic phrasing.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: いや、あっさり儲けが出るほど甘くはなかった。困難を克服するのに何年もかかったよ。
lines.en: No, it wasn't easy enough to turn a profit quickly. Overcoming the hardships took us many years.
lines.style: Reflective elder, slight chuckle, candid about past struggles.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 組織の階層が固まってからは、後継者選びも難しかったのではないでしょうか。
lines.en: Once the organizational hierarchy solidified, choosing a successor must have been difficult too.
lines.style: Thoughtful student probing deeper, formal interview register.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: その通り。私が辞任する際、有力な候補が二人いてね。最終的に創業メンバーの意向を確認して、息子に事業を継承させた。
lines.en: Exactly. When I resigned, there were two strong candidates. In the end, I confirmed the founders' wishes and passed the business to my son.
lines.style: Measured elder explaining a weighty decision with quiet pride.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: なるほど。最後に、これから起業する学生に一言いただけますか。
lines.en: I see. Lastly, could you give one piece of advice to students starting businesses?
lines.style: Closing interview question, warm and grateful tone.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 目先の儲けより、自分のビジョンを信じなさい。それが何より大事だよ。
lines.en: Believe in your own vision rather than short-term profit. That matters more than anything.
lines.style: Sincere parting wisdom from elder, calm and firm closing line.
